visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: equals Overloaded Instead of Overridden
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Two equal points should collapse to one entry in a HashSet (size 1), but the set holds 2.

solution.explanation: equals(Point) is a different method (an overload) from equals(Object). HashSet calls equals(Object), which is still the inherited identity comparison, so equal-looking points are treated as different. Always write equals(Object) and add @Override so the compiler checks it.
